name: Salesforce
description: Enterprise CRM platform for sales, service, and marketing automation
evidence: Well-documented REST/SOAP APIs, OAuth 2.0 with multiple flows. Free developer edition available. MCP servers exist (community).

name: HubSpot
description: Inbound marketing, sales, and CRM platform
evidence: Extensive REST API. Free CRM tier. Private app tokens or OAuth. Official MCP server available.

name: Pipedrive
description: Sales CRM and pipeline management tool
evidence: REST API with API token or OAuth 2.0. 14-day free trial. Comprehensive endpoints for deals, contacts, activities.

name: Attio
description: Modern flexible CRM with custom objects and workflows
evidence: REST API. OAuth 2.0 for multi-workspace, API keys for single workspace. Free plan available with API access.

name: Twenty
description: Open-source CRM alternative to Salesforce
evidence: REST + GraphQL APIs. Open-source, fully self-hostable. API keys via Settings. OAuth with PKCE support.

name: Podio
description: Flexible work management and collaboration platform by Citrix
evidence: REST API with OAuth 2.0. Free plan for up to 5 users. Full CRUD on items, apps, tasks.

name: Zoho CRM
description: Cloud-based CRM with sales automation and analytics
evidence: REST API v7. OAuth 2.0 via Zoho Developer Console. Free edition for up to 3 users.

name: Close
description: Sales CRM with built-in calling and email
evidence: REST API. API key (Basic Auth) or OAuth 2.0. 14-day free trial. Comprehensive lead/contact/opportunity endpoints.

name: Copper
description: CRM built for Google Workspace
evidence: REST API with API key + email header auth. 14-day trial. Endpoints for people, companies, opportunities.

name: DealCloud
description: Deal and relationship management for capital markets
evidence: OAuth2 Client Credentials flow. Swagger docs per instance. Requires admin approval + client status. No free tier.

name: Zendesk
description: Customer service and engagement platform
evidence: REST API. API token or OAuth 2.0. Free trial available. MCP servers exist (community). Very broad API surface.

name: Intercom
description: Customer messaging platform with bots and inbox
evidence: REST API v2. Access tokens or OAuth 2.0. Free trial. Broad API: conversations, contacts, articles, tags.

name: Freshdesk
description: Cloud-based helpdesk and customer support
evidence: REST API v2. API key via profile settings. Free plan for up to 2 agents. Tickets, contacts, solutions endpoints.

name: Front
description: Shared inbox and customer communication platform
evidence: REST API. API tokens or OAuth 2.0. Free trial. Conversations, messages, contacts, tags endpoints.

name: Pylon
description: B2B customer support across Slack, Teams, email
main_blocker: Limited API surface, admin-only token generation
evidence: REST API. Bearer token auth. Admin-only API token creation. Rate limit 60 req/min. Newer product, API still growing.

name: LiveAgent
description: All-in-one helpdesk with live chat, ticketing, call center
evidence: REST API v3. API key via Configuration > System > API. Free trial (14-day). Swagger docs per instance.

name: Plain
description: API-first customer support platform for B2B
evidence: GraphQL API. API key (Bearer token) via Machine Users. Free plan available. TypeScript SDK provided. API-first design.

name: Help Scout
description: Helpdesk and knowledge base for customer support
evidence: REST API (Mailbox 2.0). OAuth 2.0 or API key. 15-day free trial. Conversations, customers, mailboxes endpoints.

name: Gorgias
description: Ecommerce helpdesk for Shopify, Magento, BigCommerce
evidence: REST API. HTTP Basic (email + API key) for private apps, OAuth2 for public. 7-day trial. Tickets, customers, macros.

name: Gladly
description: People-centered customer service platform
main_blocker: No free tier, contact sales for access
evidence: REST API. Basic Auth (email + API token). OAuth for App Platform. No free tier, enterprise-focused. Sandbox available for clients.

name: Slack
description: Business messaging and collaboration platform
evidence: Web API (REST), Events API, RTM. OAuth 2.0 with granular scopes. Free plan. MCP servers available (community + official).

name: Twilio
description: Cloud communications platform for SMS, voice, video
evidence: REST API. Account SID + Auth Token (Basic Auth). Free trial with credits. Extremely broad API: SMS, Voice, Video, WhatsApp.

name: Zoho Cliq
description: Team communication and collaboration by Zoho
main_blocker: Smaller user base, limited third-party ecosystem
evidence: REST API via Zoho OAuth 2.0. Free plan. API for messages, channels, bots, widgets.

name: Lark (Larksuite)
description: Enterprise collaboration suite by ByteDance
evidence: REST APIs. App access tokens or OAuth. Free plan available. Broad API: messaging, docs, calendar, approval.

name: Pumble
description: Free team messaging app by CAKE.com
main_blocker: Limited API surface, relatively new API
evidence: REST API via API addon. API key generated via slash command. Free plan. Swagger docs. Also Pumble SDK for marketplace apps.

name: Discord
description: Communication platform for communities and gaming
evidence: REST + Gateway (WebSocket) API. Bot tokens or OAuth2. Free. Broad API: guilds, channels, messages, interactions.

name: Telegram
description: Cloud-based messaging with bot platform
evidence: Bot API (REST). Bot token via @BotFather. Completely free. Broad API: messages, groups, inline queries, payments.

name: WhatsApp Business
description: Business messaging via WhatsApp
main_blocker: Meta Business verification required, per-message pricing
evidence: Cloud API (REST). System User tokens or OAuth via Meta. Free tier with limited conversations. Business verification needed.

name: Aircall
description: Cloud-based phone system for sales and support
evidence: REST API. Basic Auth (API ID + token) or OAuth 2.0. Free trial. Calls, users, contacts, teams endpoints.

name: Vonage
description: Cloud communications APIs for messaging, voice, video
evidence: REST APIs. API key+secret or JWT. Free trial credits. Broad: SMS, Voice, Video, Verify, Messages API.

name: Google Ads
description: Online advertising platform by Google
main_blocker: Developer token approval process, complex OAuth setup
evidence: REST/gRPC API. OAuth 2.0 + developer token. Free to use API but needs Google Ads account. Developer token requires approval.

name: Meta Ads
description: Advertising platform for Facebook and Instagram
evidence: Graph API (REST). OAuth 2.0 via Meta for Developers. Free. Requires app review for production. Broad ad management APIs.

name: LinkedIn Ads
description: B2B advertising on LinkedIn
main_blocker: Restrictive API access, partner program required for full access
evidence: REST API. OAuth 2.0. Free developer app but Marketing API requires partner approval. Limited self-serve access.

name: GoHighLevel
description: All-in-one marketing and CRM platform for agencies
evidence: REST API v2. OAuth 2.0 or Private Integration Tokens. 14-day trial. Broad API: contacts, funnels, calendars, workflows.

name: Mailchimp
description: Email marketing and automation platform
evidence: REST API v3. API key or OAuth 2.0. Free plan (500 contacts). Broad: campaigns, lists, templates, automations.

name: Klaviyo
description: Email and SMS marketing for ecommerce
evidence: REST API. Private API key or OAuth 2.0. Free plan (250 contacts). Broad: profiles, campaigns, flows, segments.

name: systeme.io
description: All-in-one marketing platform with funnels, email, courses
main_blocker: Limited API surface (contacts, tags, custom fields only)
evidence: REST API. API key in header. Free plan. API limited to contacts, tags, custom fields, courses. No funnel/page management via API.

name: Pinterest
description: Visual discovery and bookmarking platform
evidence: REST API v5. OAuth 2.0. Free developer app. Pins, boards, ads, analytics endpoints.

name: Threads (Meta)
description: Text-based social media app by Meta
main_blocker: Very new API, limited endpoints, app review required
evidence: Graph API (REST). OAuth 2.0 via Meta. Free. Limited to publishing, reading threads, user insights. Still maturing.

name: SendGrid
description: Cloud-based email delivery and marketing
evidence: REST API v3. API key in Authorization header. Free tier (100 emails/day). Broad: mail send, contacts, templates, stats.

name: Shopify
description: Ecommerce platform for online stores
evidence: REST + GraphQL Admin API, Storefront API. OAuth for public apps, API key for custom. Free trial. Very broad API surface.

name: WooCommerce
description: Open-source ecommerce plugin for WordPress
evidence: REST API. OAuth 1.0a or Basic Auth (consumer key/secret). Free/open-source. Broad: products, orders, customers, coupons.

name: BigCommerce
description: SaaS ecommerce platform for growing businesses
evidence: REST API. OAuth access token or API account credentials. 15-day trial. Broad: catalog, orders, customers, storefront.

name: Salesforce Commerce Cloud
description: Enterprise ecommerce platform by Salesforce
evidence: OCAPI + Commerce API (REST). OAuth 2.0 via SLAS. Enterprise product, contact sales. Broad API but requires Salesforce contract.

name: Magento (Adobe Commerce)
description: Open-source ecommerce platform (Adobe Commerce)
evidence: REST + GraphQL APIs. OAuth 1.0a, token-based, or admin tokens. Open-source (Magento OS is free). Broad API surface.

name: Squarespace
description: Website builder and ecommerce platform
evidence: REST API. OAuth 2.0 or API key. 14-day trial. Commerce orders, inventory, profiles. Not full CMS management via API.

name: Ecwid
description: Embeddable ecommerce solution
evidence: REST API. OAuth 2.0 or secret API key. Free plan available. Products, orders, customers, categories endpoints.

name: Gumroad
description: Platform for creators to sell digital products
evidence: REST API. OAuth 2.0 or access token. Free to use (fee per sale). Limited: products, sales, subscribers, license verification.

name: Amazon Selling Partner
description: Amazon marketplace seller APIs
main_blocker: Complex registration, paid seller account needed, lengthy approval
evidence: REST API. OAuth 2.0 + LWA (Login with Amazon). Requires Professional Seller account ($39.99/mo). Complex app registration.

name: fanbasis
description: Creator monetization platform (also known as Commas)
evidence: REST API (Commas API). API key auth. NPM checkout SDK available. Payment links, subscriptions, customers. Newer/smaller platform.

name: DataForSEO
description: SEO data API for keyword, SERP, and backlink data
evidence: REST API. Basic Auth (login + password). Free trial credits. Broad: SERP, keywords, backlinks, on-page, content analysis.

name: SE Ranking
description: All-in-one SEO software with rank tracking and audit
evidence: REST API. Token auth in header or query param. Trial available. Data API + Project API for rank tracking, analysis.

name: Ahrefs
description: SEO toolset for backlinks, keywords, and site audit
main_blocker: Paid plan required, API access on higher tiers only
evidence: REST API. Bearer token. API access requires paid subscription (starts at higher tiers). Backlinks, keywords, site explorer.

name: MrScraper
description: Web scraping API with browser automation
evidence: REST API. x-api-token header. Free tier with token-based billing. Scraper management and data retrieval endpoints.

name: Apify
description: Web scraping and automation platform
evidence: REST API v2. API token in header. Free tier. Broad: actors, runs, datasets, key-value stores, webhooks. MCP server available.

name: Firecrawl
description: Web scraping API that converts pages to LLM-ready markdown
evidence: REST API. Bearer token. Free tier (500 credits). Scrape, crawl, map endpoints. Official MCP server. Open-source option.

name: Bright Data
description: Web data platform with proxies and scraping infrastructure
evidence: REST API + proxy credentials. Bearer token for API, username/password for proxies. Free trial. Broad: SERP, web scraper, datasets.

name: Sherlock
description: Open-source CLI for finding usernames across social networks
main_blocker: CLI tool only, no REST API, no hosted service
evidence: Python CLI tool. No API, no auth. Fully open-source. Would need wrapping as a service to become agent-callable.

name: Waterfall.io
description: B2B data enrichment aggregator across 30+ data vendors
main_blocker: Paid plans required for API access
evidence: REST API. x-api-key header. Paid plans for API access. Contact enrichment, company intel, email verification, prospecting.

name: Clay
description: GTM data enrichment and outbound automation platform
main_blocker: API is limited, platform is primarily UI-driven
evidence: REST API. clay-api-key header. Free tier available. API mainly for search/routines, most power is in the Clay UI.

name: GitHub
description: Code hosting, version control, and collaboration platform
evidence: REST + GraphQL API. PATs, OAuth Apps, GitHub Apps. Free. Extremely broad API. Official MCP server by GitHub.

name: Vercel
description: Frontend cloud platform for deploying web apps
evidence: REST API. Bearer token (PAT or OAuth). Free Hobby tier. Deployments, domains, projects, env vars, logs endpoints.

name: Netlify
description: Web development platform for deploying modern sites
evidence: REST API. PAT or OAuth 2.0. Free Starter tier. Sites, deploys, forms, DNS, functions endpoints.

name: Cloudflare
description: Web security, performance, and edge computing platform
evidence: REST API v4. API token or Global API key. Free tier. Very broad: DNS, zones, Workers, R2, Pages, firewall. MCP available.

name: Supabase
description: Open-source Firebase alternative with Postgres
evidence: REST API (PostgREST) + client libraries. API keys (anon/service_role). Free tier. Auth, database, storage, edge functions. MCP available.

name: Neo4j
description: Graph database platform
evidence: HTTP API + Bolt protocol. Basic Auth. Free Community Edition + AuraDB Free tier. Cypher query-based rather than REST CRUD.

name: Snowflake
description: Cloud data warehouse and analytics platform
evidence: SQL API (REST). OAuth, JWT key-pair, or Basic. 30-day trial. Broad: SQL execution, stages, pipes, tasks. Enterprise pricing.

name: MongoDB Atlas
description: Cloud database service for MongoDB
evidence: Atlas Admin API + Data API. API keys or OAuth (Service Accounts). Free tier (512MB). Clusters, databases, data access. MCP available.

name: Datadog
description: Cloud monitoring and analytics platform
evidence: REST API v1/v2. API key + Application key in headers. 14-day trial. Very broad: metrics, events, dashboards, monitors, logs.

name: Sentry
description: Application monitoring and error tracking
evidence: REST API. Auth tokens or OAuth. Free Developer tier. Projects, issues, events, releases endpoints. MCP server available.

name: Notion
description: All-in-one workspace for notes, docs, wikis, and databases
evidence: REST API. Internal integration tokens or OAuth 2.0. Free plan. Pages, databases, blocks, users. Official MCP server.

name: Airtable
description: Spreadsheet-database hybrid for teams
evidence: REST API. PATs or OAuth 2.0. Free plan. Full CRUD on bases, tables, records, fields. Well-documented.

name: Linear
description: Issue tracking and project management for software teams
evidence: GraphQL API. Personal API keys or OAuth 2.0. Free plan. Issues, projects, teams, cycles, labels. MCP server available.

name: Jira
description: Project and issue tracking by Atlassian
evidence: REST API v3. API tokens (Basic) or OAuth 2.0 (3LO). Free plan (10 users). Very broad API surface. MCP servers exist.

name: Asana
description: Work management and project tracking platform
evidence: REST API. PATs or OAuth 2.0. Free plan (15 users). Tasks, projects, workspaces, portfolios, goals endpoints.

name: Monday.com
description: Work OS for project management and workflows
evidence: GraphQL API (v2). API tokens or OAuth 2.0. Free plan (2 seats). Boards, items, columns, updates, groups endpoints.

name: ClickUp
description: All-in-one project management and productivity tool
evidence: REST API v2. PATs or OAuth 2.0. Free plan. Tasks, lists, spaces, time tracking, goals, docs endpoints.

name: Coda
description: Doc-powered workspace with tables and automations
evidence: REST API v1. Bearer API token. Free plan. Docs, tables, rows, formulas, automations endpoints.

name: Smartsheet
description: Enterprise work management and collaboration
evidence: REST API 2.0. API access token or OAuth 2.0. 30-day trial. Sheets, rows, columns, reports, dashboards.

name: Harvest
description: Time tracking and invoicing tool
evidence: REST API v2. PATs or OAuth 2.0. Free plan (1 user, 2 projects). Time entries, projects, clients, invoices endpoints.

name: Stripe
description: Payment processing and financial infrastructure
evidence: REST API. Secret API key in header. Free to create account (pay-as-you-go). Extremely broad: payments, subscriptions, billing. MCP server.

name: Plaid
description: Financial data API for bank account linking
evidence: REST API. Client ID + Secret. Free sandbox environment. Broad: transactions, auth, identity, investments, liabilities.

name: Binance
description: Cryptocurrency exchange platform
evidence: REST + WebSocket API. API key + HMAC-SHA256 signature. Free account. Broad: spot, futures, margin, market data.

name: Paygent Connect
description: AI-native payment platform (NMI-powered)
main_blocker: Limited public docs, contact sales needed
evidence: REST API. Bearer token auth. Limited public documentation. Newer platform, appears to require outreach for full API access.

name: iPayX
description: FX verification and audit engine, MCP-native
evidence: REST API + MCP SSE server. API key or MCP auth. FINTRAC-registered MSB. Niche FX audit use case. MCP-native design.

name: QuickBooks
description: Accounting software by Intuit
evidence: REST API. OAuth 2.0. Free developer sandbox. Broad: invoices, payments, customers, vendors, reports, journal entries.

name: Xero
description: Cloud-based accounting software
evidence: REST API. OAuth 2.0 (PKCE). 30-day trial. Broad: invoices, contacts, accounts, bank transactions, payroll.

name: Brex
description: Corporate card and spend management platform
evidence: REST API. User tokens or OAuth 2.0. Free to apply for Brex. Transactions, cards, users, budgets, transfers endpoints.

name: Ramp
description: Corporate card and expense management
evidence: REST API. OAuth 2.0 (Client Credentials). Free to apply. Transactions, cards, users, reimbursements. Sandbox available.

name: PitchBook
description: Financial data and research platform for VC/PE
main_blocker: Enterprise contract required, no self-serve access
evidence: REST API. PB-Token header. Requires enterprise contract + API credits purchase. No self-serve. Sandbox for clients only.

name: NotebookLM
description: AI-powered research and note-taking tool by Google
main_blocker: No public API for consumer version; Enterprise API requires Google Cloud
evidence: No public consumer API. Enterprise API via Gemini Notebook Enterprise (Google Cloud IAM + OAuth). Unofficial wrappers exist.

name: Otter AI
description: AI meeting transcription and note-taking
main_blocker: API gated to Enterprise tier only
evidence: REST API (Enterprise only). Bearer token. MCP server available (OAuth). API requires Enterprise workspace + account manager.

name: Fathom
description: AI meeting recorder with summaries and action items
evidence: REST API. X-Api-Key header. Free plan available. Meetings, transcripts, summaries. Rate limited. TypeScript/Python SDKs.

name: Consensus
description: AI-powered academic research search engine
main_blocker: API access by application, per-call pricing
evidence: REST API. OAuth 2.0 with PKCE. API access by application + per-call pricing (~$0.10/call). MCP setup available. 220M+ papers.

name: Reducto
description: AI document parsing API (PDF, images to structured data)
evidence: REST API. Bearer token. Free account at studio.reducto.ai. Python/Node.js/Go SDKs. Parse, extract, chunk documents.

name: Devin
description: AI software engineer for autonomous coding
evidence: REST API. Bearer token (cog_ prefix). MCP server at mcp.devin.ai. Sessions, knowledge, playbooks, secrets. Paid plans required.

name: higgsfield
description: AI content creation suite with CLI and MCP
evidence: REST API + CLI + MCP. OAuth login for CLI, API key for SDK. Free tier with credits. MCP server available. Video/image generation.

name: Mermaid CLI
description: CLI tool for generating diagrams from Mermaid markdown
main_blocker: CLI tool only, no hosted API
evidence: Node.js CLI tool. No auth, no API. Open-source. Would need wrapping as a service. Not agent-callable as-is.

name: YouTube Transcript
description: API service for extracting YouTube video transcripts
evidence: REST API. Bearer token. Free tier available. Transcript extraction, search, channel/playlist. MCP integration available.

name: Grain
description: AI meeting recording, transcription, and coaching
main_blocker: API requires Business plan or higher
evidence: REST API. Bearer token (PAT or WAT). Business plan required for API. MCP server at api.grain.com/_/mcp. Meetings, transcripts.
